text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear paragraphing with transitions like \"However,\" \"In addition,\" and \"In summarize,\"","quality":"organization","description":"The essay is organized into recognizable sections and uses discourse markers to guide the reader through its points."},{"evidence":"sentence frames such as \"However, everybody wants to have a great life\" and \"In addition, is not only about be a professional or success\"","quality":"control of academic expository style","description":"The writing more consistently uses an essay-like explanatory tone rather than fragmented or list-like wording."},{"evidence":"more extended connected sentences","quality":"sentence development","description":"Ideas are developed in longer, more continuous sentences instead of mostly broken phrases and isolated fragments."},{"evidence":"wording like \"we have to work harder to get it\" and \"have a better communication with people that we love\"","quality":"message clarity","description":"The main ideas are easier to follow and stay more coherent across the essay."},{"evidence":"fewer severely distorted phrases than A","quality":"language control","description":"Although error-prone, the essay shows somewhat better overall control of English grammar and word formation."}]}
